mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the discount rate for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window

mechanism_narrative: A labor market tightness condition, defined as the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 5.0%, signals an overheating economy that prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when UNRATE > 5.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in inflation (CPIAUCSL > 200) and decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 110) signals stagflation, which triggers a negative market reaction due to policy uncertainty and reduced corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) in periods when CPIAUCSL > 200 and INDPRO < 110, or the interaction term's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a high level of housing starts (HOUST > 1500) signals overbuilding and potential economic overheating, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) in late-cycle expansion periods when HOUST > 1500, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing activity, which supports corporate earnings growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window

mechanism_narrative: A labor market weakening condition, defined as employment (PAYEMS) falling below 135000, signals reduced consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when PAYEMS < 135000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 200) and high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%) signals an aggressive monetary tightening cycle, which compresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) in periods when CPIAUCSL > 200 and FEDFUNDS > 5.0, or the interaction term's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-recession recovery regime, a high level of retail sales (RSAFS > 360000) signals strong consumer demand and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) in post-recession recovery periods when RSAFS > 360000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
